t: Lesson 1 -  The 6 Main Areas of Music
c: ABSOLUTELY UNDERSTAND GUITAR - Lessons and Theory

q.x: If you are learning the guitar and are interested in music theory (or meta-learning), one resource I cannot recommend enough is Absolutely Understand Guitar by Scotty West[1]. These are old video lectures from 1999 which have since been uploaded to YouTube.

desc: Before you will understand the guitar, you have to understand MUSIC. Music is a language. It has an ALPHABET and 6 parts of speech. You'll learn about all of it here in Lesson 1. Make sure you watch our 32 video lessons IN ORDER.
